title: Drug Use, Nudity, and Sexual Fetishes All in GTA 6
summary: Age rating descriptions share the details

Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 Grand Theft Auto GTA Drug Use, Nudity, and Sexual Fetishes All in GTA 6 Age rating descriptions share the details by Liam Croft 3 hours ago Share: GTA 6 really is imminent now: the official age ratings for the PS5, Xbox Series X|S title have been published as the 19th November 2026 release date nears. Unsurprisingly, the game is rated M for Mature in the USA and 18+ in the UK. However, it is the content descriptions tied to these age ratings that provide the interesting details. As per the PEGI website , you can expect drug use, nudity, sexual intercourse, sexual fetishes, strip club interactions with breasts and bottom touching, and swearing. The description starts with a general overview of the sort of violence GTA 6 contains: This game contains frequent depictions of violence; due to the free roam nature of the game the player can harm all other characters inhabiting the environment. This includes civilians, criminals and the authorities. Violence is bloody with a high degree of realism, with certain weapons being able to cause greater damage such as detailed decapitation and dismemberment. Wildlife! Activities It then touches on drug use in GTA 6, specifically highlighting cocaine. The use of drugs is "frequent and prominent", and you can put drugs in an inventory slot for you to use with other characters. "Most notably, cocaine can be carried around by the player and snorted directly from their hand at any time." Next up is sex, which is also frequent in the game. There'll be nudity, scenes of sexual intercourse, and even some sexual fetishes on display. You'll be able to go to strip clubs and pay for private dances from the workers there, and you can move your hands onto the dancers' breasts and bottom. As an aside, four more screenshots have also been revealed today: Something I always struggle with is harming animals in-game, and you can do that in GTA 6. You can kill animals that are roaming about the open world, but their deaths don't come with as much injury detail as humans. Obviously, there's also a lot of swearing, with the PEGI description highlighting f*ck and c*nt as two swear words in the game. It then mentions discriminatory language appearing in the TV shows you can watch in-game and the radio stations your car can be tuned to. What do you make of this? Post your thoughts in the comments below.
